notes.title: Kamilia Release Date Update
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/c0953d2f264690a4d98de86df05202c0fa468b07.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/h2][p]Thank you so much for supporting [i]Kamilia[/i] — whether by wishlisting the game, playing the demo, or simply following the project. It means a great deal.[/p][p]After thoughtful consideration, the release of [i]Kamilia[/i] is being rescheduled,[/p][p]from [b]Q4 2025 [/b]to[b] Q2 2026.[/b][/p][p]Below are more details about the delay, along with a special reveal—[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/724a278d3af6a8cc6627dd22923f4cbf3a246857.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Why the Delay?[/b][/p][p]Kamilia is based on a novel written over a decade ago. Early in development, the plan was to adapt only the main parts of the original story.[/p][p]But as development progressed, it became clear that many of those character-driven moments carried too much meaning to be left out.[/p][p]Therefore, it was recently decided to include the full story as it was originally told, in order to create the complete emotional experience.[/p][p]The additional time will also allow for some early chapters to be revisited and polished further.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/05ce001af21ceccb8f1f4009fb620661904dc162.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]A Small Reveal [/b]🤫[/h3][p]As a small token of gratitude for your patience, here’s something never shared before:
As stated on the Steam page, the game will have multiple endings, but here’s a more specific detail -[/p][h3][b]Kamilia will feature FOUR different endings,[/b][/h3][p][b]along with different endings for some of the side characters.
[/b][/p][p]Thanks again for your continued interest in [i]Kamilia[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]Warmly,
Raphael Barel,
[b]RQ Play[/b][/p]

notes.title: FULL PC & Mac Support + Cloud Sync Confirmed!
notes.content:
As we get closer to the DEMO launch next week, on April 1st, I'm happy to announce -

[b]Kamilia will officially support both PC & Mac, and also fully support [b]Steam Save Cloud Sync
[/b]So whether you're playing on Windows or macOS, you’ll be able to pick up right where you left off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45069340/d6040567ff26de686c51ccd3d656444c79f26a24.jpg[/img]
[h2][b]Thanks for following the journey 🤍[/b][/h2]
